finding: Founder-inventor overlap on Celyad WO2020221873; sequence identity vs claims tops out at 47%.

meta.task_framing_correction: The task described WO2020221873 as an 'anti-BCMA VHH-CAR' patent. It is not one by its own vocabulary: 'VHH', 'single domain' and 'single-domain' each appear ZERO times in Celyad's full text (vs 70 occurrences of 'VHH' in Company C's).
meta.celyad_actual_claim: Conventional VH/VL scFv (scFv #11, SEQ ID NO: 14), whose 6 claimed CDRs are VH/VL, not VHH.
meta.vhh_material_in_celyad: SEQ ID NO: 15, a comparator construct derived from the first 295 aa of a sequence in WO2018028647. Never called a VHH by the patent. No CDRs disclosed for it. All Celyad 'VHH CDRs' used in the comparison are ANARCI computational delineations and are labelled as such.
meta.numbering_scheme: Neither patent states a scheme. Inferred by reproduction test: Celyad = Kabat (6/6 exact). Company C = IMGT-family (CDR1 28/28, CDR3 27/28, CDR2 only 8/28, Company C's own CDR2 boundary is internally inconsistent).
meta.retrieval_note: WIPO PATENTSCOPE returned HTTP 403 on all four endpoints. Both official PDFs are image-only scans (102 and 264 characters extracted across 52 and 133 pages). The Company C listing was recovered by transcribing 31 embedded table images and validated: 84 of 84 listed VHH CDRs match their stated parent VHH as exact substrings.

structural_observations: All six 80%+ hits are CDR2-vs-CDR2. All six are against the same Celyad comparator construct (SEQ ID NO: 15 domain 2), NOT against Celyad's claimed scFv #11.
The 87.5% pair's Kabat window includes near-invariant VHH framework-2 residues (YYADSVKG/AYADSVKG), so the Kabat figure is inflated by framework rather than paratope.
The xGSGGST CDR2 motif underlying the top hits recurs across many unrelated Company C binders in their own listing, so its distinctiveness is questionable.
